description: This file defines a Kotlin class ListFragment that extends Android's Fragment. It displays different sections of an app using mock API data, with dynamic content based on specified section types such as donations, volunteers, projects, donor CRM, reports, and settings. It sets up a RecyclerView to list data retrieved asynchronously from a mock API and handles UI updates accordingly.

classes.name: ListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of items based on the specified kind, utilizing mock API data and supporting multiple section types.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView and its adapter, determines the list kind, fetches data asynchronously, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ListFragment with the specified kind argument.
